import { type PropertyValues } from 'lit';
import { FormElement } from '../catalog-support.js';
export declare class RangeSlider extends FormElement {
    static formAssociated: boolean;
    static properties: {
        value: {
            type: NumberConstructor;
        };
        defaultValue: {
            type: NumberConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        min: {
            type: NumberConstructor;
        };
        max: {
            type: NumberConstructor;
        };
        step: {
            type: NumberConstructor;
        };
        valueText: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
    };
    value: number | undefined;
    defaultValue: number | undefined;
    min: number;
    max: number;
    step: number;
    valueText: ((value: number) => string) | undefined;
    private state;
    constructor();
    get committedValue(): number;
    resetControl(): void;
    restoreControl(value: string | FormData | File | null): void;
    updated(_changed: PropertyValues): void;
    private input;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
